answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring each identity to lock a separate refundable deposit that unlocks only after a long period of verified honest trading. Random peer audits publish a public signal when an agent's record checks out, and cheating burns that deposit outright. An honest agent earns its standing slowly, like a pearl forming layer by layer, and harvests the nectar of trust once; an attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must lock a thousand deposits and wait out a thousand unlocking periods, so each clone costs real capital and time instead of being free to copy.
